methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 cordless impact driver models from DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, Bosch, Ryobi, Ridgid, Metabo HPT, and Craftsman, spanning ~2015-2023 release years, selected for high search volume and broad market representation. Specs independently re-verified (2026-06-19) against manufacturer pages and reputable tool-review outlets (Pro Tool Reviews, Tool Guyd) plus authorized dealers (Acme Tools, Burns Tools, Life and Home). voltage_v is nominal platform voltage; max_torque_in_lb is the manufacturer-stated peak in-lb figure; max_rpm and max_ipm are the highest no-load figures across all modes; brushless is a boolean; speed_settings is the count of distinct preset speed/mode positions (1 = variable-speed trigger only, no selector); weight_lb is the bare-tool (no battery) figure where published, otherwise null. priceUsd is the US MSRP or published bare-tool retail price unless priceNote states otherwise. All specs in the draft survived adversarial re-verification; no products were fabricated or removed. Minor source/note corrections applied per provenance fields.

products.name: 20V MAX XR 3-Speed 1/4 in. Impact Driver (Tool Only)
